messages:
Megan: Quick sync — we need final changelog + docs links for the release announcement on Thursday. Webinar scheduled Tue 09:00 PT (marketing slot). Can we lock rollout timing and brief benchmark narrative for the blog and slides?

Andre: I can own the changelog. Will open a PR today. Proposed rollout: canary (30m) -> staged (2h) -> full. Need prod window from SRE for the 30m canary. Also: add fallback policy to use the smaller quantized model if GPU pool fills.

Sasha: Docs: I'll publish the user-facing guide + API examples once I have the final changelog and sample requests. Draft is here: https://redwood.docs.internal/drafts/release-x (please don't share externally). Need a short curl example and an SDK snippet for Node + Python.

Liam: Bench numbers from last run (internal perf job 2154319001): p50=92ms, p95=210ms, 1M-token cost delta ~ $180 (approx $0.18/token unit in our accounting). I can write a one-paragraph benchmark summary for the blog: highlight latency improvements and cost/unit. Will push PR with a small table and graph links.

Olivia: Messaging note — marketing wants a 2–3 sentence lead for the announcement that focuses on: predictable latency, lower unit cost, and canary rollouts for reliability. Keep technical details in the blog/docs. Also confirm demo for the webinar uses the new streaming + tool-calling example.

Megan: @Andre can you paste the changelog PR link here when ready? @Liam can you give a 1‑sentence headline of the bench numbers we can use in the hero? @Sasha I'll add the SDK snippets once you post the example requests.

Andre: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/842 — includes changelog entry and rollout notes. Changelog snippet: 

```
- Release v1.14.0 — improved runtime kernel selection and prefix KV caching.
  - Latency: ~15% p50 improvement for short sequences.
  - Cost: ~12% token cost reduction with default batching.
  - Rollout: 30m canary -> 2h staged -> full.
```

Andre: SRE confirmed canary window slot at Thu 16:00 UTC. DeployBot will handle staged cutover.

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy for release v1.14.0 at 2026-04-23T16:00:00Z (canary 30m, staged 2h). Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/12345

Liam: Bench headline suggestion: "15% median latency improvement and 12% lower token cost in our standard web-chat workload" — feel free to tighten. Full numbers + graphs in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-reports/pull/78

Sasha: Curl example draft for docs (will add SDK soon):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.14-opt","input":"Summarize the commit message"}'
```

Olivia: Webinar outline — 20m talk (product + eng), 20m demo (streaming + tools), 15m Q&A. Marketing will collect questions in the signup form and route hot leads to sales in real time. Need the final demo script by Mon EOD so ops can rehearse.

Megan: Action items: Andre — finalize changelog PR and add rollback notes (assigned), Sasha — publish docs with curl + SDK snippets once PRs are merged, Liam — finalize bench summary and hero line, Olivia — finalize webinar deck and demo script, Marketing — prepare landing page + lead routing (GDPR check). Can everyone ack? :thumbsup:

Andre: ack

Sasha: ack

Liam: ack

Olivia: ack

Megan: thanks team — will follow up with the press schedule and embargo window.

Megan: (later) small tweak: canary start moved to 16:30 UTC — DeployBot updated schedule.

DeployBot: Updated deploy schedule: canary start 2026-04-23T16:30:00Z.

Megan: Final note for comms: if perf regressions >5% on p95 we abort canary and rollback automatically. Please ensure alerts are on. Thanks!"
